programme.title: Back To The Future III [P13]
programme.desc: In Back to the Future Part III, Marty travels to 1885 to save Doc from an outlaw. Packed with laughs, action, and heart, it’s the epic Wild West finale to the beloved trilogy.

programme.title: Jurassic Park [P13]
programme.desc: An industrialist invites some experts to visit his theme park of cloned dinosaurs. After a power failure, the creatures run loose, putting everyone's lives, including his grandchildren's, in danger.

programme.title: Tim [P13]
programme.desc: A somewhat mentally handicapped 20-year-old man works as a laborer, but everyone abuses his naiveté. A nice 40-year-old American woman hires him one day and they become close. However, the town and his family see her as predatory.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 21 [P13]
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family’s debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha’s lives?

programme.title: TEBARAN HATI EPS 71 [P13]
programme.desc: This story begins with Ariana, a renowned reporter and the adopted daughter of the respected Prawira family. She is willing to sacrifice everything to protect the good name of the family that raised her. When Ladya, her adopted younger sister, becomes depressed after getting pregnant out of wedlock and being abandoned by her boyfriend who flees abroad, to the point of attempting suicide, Ariana is asked by her adoptive mother, Indar, to claim the baby as her own. This decision shatters Ariana’s career and calls off her wedding to Kai, her boyfriend from a wealthy family.

programme.title: CINTA TANPA KARENA EPS 451 [P13]

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 75 [P13]
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husband—Lala enters the third season of the Champion of Chef cooking competition, and her victory brings her closer to Julian, one of the judges in the competition.

programme.title: MENCINTAI IPAR SENDIRI EPS 106 [P13]
programme.desc: Ayuna, a beauty vlogger and model, finishes a shoot and is picked up by her younger sister, Bella. Bella takes Ayuna to a workshop to give her a surprise: Ayuna’s sports car has been upgraded as a gift, since Bella is getting married before her older sister. Bella then asks Ayuna to have one last race on a deserted road as her farewell to the racing world, a request that Ayuna agrees to with a heavy heart.

programme.title: KESETIAAN JANJI CINTA EPS 49 [P13]
programme.desc: Meira no longer feels happy in her marriage. Lately, Arya, her husband, constantly looks for faults in her. As a result, Meira and Arya often get into arguments. The situation reaches its peak when Arya refuses to provide for Meira anymore. He even refuses to help cover the medical expenses of Meira’s mother, Siti. Arya also stops paying for Lani’s college tuition, Meira’s younger sister. Even though, before they got married, it was Arya who promised Meira that he would cover all of her living expenses as well as her family’s, so that she could focus on being a housewife.

programme.desc: Jimmy checks out the landscapes of Kakadu; he chats with traditional owner Mandy Muir who takes Jimmy to see her country on a boat trip along the Yellow Waters.

programme.title: Taste Of The Territory [P13]
programme.desc: Darwin's only chocolatier Leo Cleanthous shows Jimmy around his boutique chocolate cafe, Bumble Bean Chocolates.

programme.title: Taste Of The Territory [P13]
programme.desc: Jimmy visits the Darwin CBD to offer an insight into his own restaurant, Hanuman, and cooks one of his favourite childhood dishes.

programme.title: Taiwan Top 5 [P13]
programme.desc: Peggy explores Taiwan's top five alternative therapies and learns about those keeping traditional ways of healing alive today.

programme.title: Taiwan Top 5 [P13]
programme.desc: Jolie explores Taiwan's top five Western food with a Taiwanese twist. Join her as she learns why these have become so popular among locals and tourists alike.

programme.title: Taiwan Top 5 [P13]
programme.desc: Jolie explores top five temples to visit in Taipei. Join her as she learns about the deities worshipped in these temples and what people pray for at each.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapore's best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: Adam Liaw gathers what he has learned over the past few weeks to serve up an impressive five-course banquet dinner to some distinguished guests, including his mother.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his father's side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible interactions with predatory killer whales. The humpbacks also face a world full of human threats, from large container ships, to the impact of seismic testing in the search for oil and gas, now threatening their very survival once more.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOceans' scientists on an expedition to uncover more of their secrets and behaviours.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: In A 'Tale Of Two Sharks' we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the nest.

programme.title: Iceland: The Puffin Sanctuary [P13]
programme.desc: The endearing, "comical" puffin is Iceland's national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

programme.title: In The Giant Mammoth Tracks [P13]
programme.desc: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, little-known giant back to life.

programme.title: Wild Portugal [P13]
programme.desc: Portugal’s diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

programme.desc: See how ad campaigns from the '50s launched new American traditions and the promise of a bright tomorrow.

programme.title: Jaguarland [P13]

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: The worldwide pandemic ceased operations on the world's only underwater habitat. Mike Davidson joins a crack repair crew as they dive in to bring it back to life and get NASA astronauts back inside for training.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Mike Davidson joins the US Marines' 'Heavy Haulers' squadron as they're put to the test. They battle to keep their fleet of CH53 'Super Stallion' choppers flying, in preparation for intense warfare training exercises in the desert and mountains.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Jia Cai berjaya memujuk bekas pengasuhnya Kak Ying untuk menjalani pembedahan usus kerana keadaannya teramat kritikal. Jia Cai kemudiannya mengaku kepada Suk Fen bahawa Kak Ying sememangnya adalah ibu kandungnya.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Wenxue diberitahu Hero mungkin ditangkap polis, dia kemudian memutuskan untuk membiarkan ibunya bertanggungjawab atas jenayah itu sekiranya Hero mendedahkan perbuatan salah mereka. Kuro menyeksa Hero bagi mendapatkan lokasi Tianyou.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Yufei menghalang keluarga Zhihong daripada melakukan upacara kematian Tianyou. Ziting memberitahu Jialiang akan kehilangan Zixian. Dari pelbagai sudut pengesanan, Jialiang mengesyaki ibu Wenxue adalah penyebabnya.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Chee Kan mengambil gambar Jia Mei sebagai model pakaian ciptaan Kuan Zhong dengan jenama "Smile Light". Chee Lin membawa Kuan Zhong untuk melawat ibu bapanya dan yang mengejutkan, Ruguan juga ada di sana.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17
programme.desc: Xilian memerlukan wang untuk mengebumikan ayahnya. Wang Deng Fa menawarkan bantuannya dan membawanya tinggal di rumahnya untuk membantu menjaga adik iparnya yang sakit Jin Loong. Jin Loong mendedahkan kepada Xilian mengenai Wang.

programme.title: MY ONE AND ONLY
programme.desc: Semua orang cuba menghalang Renpin daripada meninggalkan My One & Only. Baoyou membantu Finn dan Evan mencari HDB di timur dan barat. Kedua-duanya berkeras mahu tinggal berhampiran ibu mereka sendiri. Andy secara aktif memburu Renpin.

programme.title: TRAVEL WITH MY LOVE
programme.desc: Episod ini memaparkan seorang artis, Jojo Goh bersama ibunya melancong ke beberapa provinsi di Turki. Antara tempat-tempat yang dilawati di negara itu ialah Kapalicarsi/Grand Bazaar di Istanbul dan Abant Lake di Bolu.

programme.title: THE LONGEST PROMISE
programme.desc: Shi Ying menjalankan soal siasat ke atas seorang banduan kaum Bing di penjara tapi banduan itu dibunuh dengan tiba-tiba. Shi Ying mengejar pembunuh sehingga membawanya masuk ke dalam sebuah alam yang aneh.

programme.title: CANTON FLAVOR SEASON 9
programme.desc: Episod ini memperkenalkan masakan-masakan keturunan Cina tempatan yang popular oleh penduduk-penduduk di Shao Guan Qu Jiang, Guang Dong Wu Chuan, Guang Dong Shen Zhen, Guang Dong Shan Tou dan Guang Dong Shun De.

programme.title: THE AIRPORT DIARY
programme.desc: Sheng An merakam sebuah video tentang keadaan kerja Henry di lapangan terbang, untuk dihantar kepada ibu mereka di Australia. Pegawai atasan Sheung Wai cuba memujuknya berhijrah ke Dubai demi tawaran gaji yang lebih baik.

programme.title: THE KING VS THE KING S9
programme.desc: Episod ini pasukan Keluarga Ace berentap dengan Pasukan Rakan dalam siri cabaran seperti meneka aksi, rebut topi, dan ujian nasib pistol air. Rancangan berakhir dengan aksi spontan yang melibatkan pengarah program sendiri.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Bok On menyeru pihak keselamatan untuk mengusir Wen Hua apabila Hua enggan keluar dari hospital. Namun, Wen Hua dimasukkan semula ke hospital apabila dia batuk darah secara tiba-tiba.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Bok On menyeru pihak keselamatan untuk mengusir Wen Hua apabila Hua enggan keluar dari hospital. Namun, Wen Hua dimasukkan semula ke hospital apabila dia batuk darah secara tiba-tiba.

programme.title: WHO RULES THE WORLD
programme.desc: Raja Negeri You mempunyai artileri yang sangat kuat. Walaupun berjaya memusnahkan salah satu artileri, Bai Feng Xi mengambil kaedah berundur untuk mengelakkan serangan Huang Chao.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Selepas dibebaskan daripada penculikan dan penyeksaan oleh Jialiang, ibu Wenxue bertengkar dengan anak perempuannya. Phang menjadi orang tengah antara keduanya. Keluarga Zhihong masih dalam keadaan sedih dengan kehilangan Tianyou.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Kimura Kenji merekrut Pi Xuen sebagai wakil Oda untuk berurusan dengan Yongsi. Kimura Kenji kemudian membawa Pi Xuen ke pejabat Yongsi. Vincent mendedahkan bahawa Pi Xuen adalah rakan universitinya.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Chee Lin sudah jatuh cinta dengan Kuan Zhong. Adakah Kuan Zhong akan membalas cintanya? Kuan Zhong kemudian terserempak dengan Pinyan yang bersama Ho dan menjemput Pinyan untuk majlis perasmian fabrik ciptaannya.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17
programme.desc: Ayah Haiyin sedang sakit dan memerlukan wang untuk membeli ubat. Shao Hua terserempak dengan seorang wanita di tempat rahsia. Wanita itu meminjamkan wang kepada Shao Hua. Shao Hua terus meminjam wang daripada wanita itu.

programme.title: RING A BELL
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan realiti di mana lebih 10 penyanyi bersaing antara satu sama lain untuk mempersembahkan trek lagu asal (OST) dari filem-filem dan drama yang popular yang membawa kenangan nostalgia menghiburkan penonton.

programme.title: THE LONGEST PROMISE
programme.desc: Shi Yu berpura-pura cedera dan pulang ke rumah. Shi Yu meminta Shi Ying untuk mengambil tempatnya dalam pemerintahan tentera Kong Sang. Setelah itu Shi Yu juga meminta Shi Ying menjadi raja muda.

programme.title: PROJECT LOVE SEASON 3
programme.desc: 8TV’s heartfelt programme Project Love Season 3 returns with warmth and purpose!Continuing the mission of the first 2 seasons touching hearts through real stories,Project Love Season 3 steps even closer into the everyday lives of ordinary Malaysians.

programme.title: THE AIRPORT DIARY
programme.desc: Chan Kit menyanyikan lagu cinta secara bersemuka kepada Joyce untuk mengaku cintanya. Sementara itu, latihan pengendalian kecemasan tahunan Lapangan Terbang Antarabangsa Hong Kong diadakan secara lancar.

programme.title: TAIWAN DEKAT JE
programme.desc: Kenji membawa Jing Yi untuk menghayati budaya muzik Taiwan yang menggabungkan elemen tradisional dan moden. Mereka melawat Pusat Muzik Taipei dan Muzium Muzik Kaoshiung yang memelihara sejarah muzik pop Mandarin.

programme.title: A GUILTY CONSCIENCE
programme.desc: Peguambela Adrian Lam (Dayo Wong) telah cuai menangani kes penderaan kanak-kanak menyebabkan Jolene Tsang (Louise Wong) yang tidak bersalah telah dijatuhkan hukuman penjara selama 17 tahun. Adrian tekad untuk membetulkan kesilapannya.

programme.title: WHO RULES THE WORLD
programme.desc: Hei Feng Xi menjadi putera raja, merancang untuk mengahwini Bai Feng Xi. Raja Qing sakit tenat, Bai Feng Xi merindui ayahnya, Raja Qing dan kembali ke negeri Qing. Huang Chao dan Yu Wu Yuan berada di kem negeri You.

programme.title: ARE YOU THE ONE
programme.desc: Qing Guo Gong menuduh Raja Huai Yang merampas segala harta benda yang ditinggalkan oleh Raja Lu. Raja Sui mengarahkan Raja Huai Yang dipenjarakan dan semua ahli keluarganya dilarang untuk meninggalkan ibu kota.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hell's Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qi's gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qi's husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: The Ones You Didn't Burn
programme.desc: After their father's death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their father's death which now threatens them both.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Windmill Massacre
